summary: The Mid York Library System emphasizes the importance of E-Rate funding for maintaining library connectivity and infrastructure, especially in rural areas. They highlight the need for a flexible discount methodology that considers local cost and provider availability. The library system opposes any sunset or reduction of E-Rate funding, arguing that it would place additional pressure on already limited library budgets and widen the digital divide for residents who rely on libraries most. The Mid York Library System urges the FCC to protect the essential support E-Rate provides for affordable broadband, internet access, internal connections, public Wi-Fi, maintenance, and cost-effective network solutions. They support thoughtful improvements that simplify the program and strengthen accountability, but not changes that weaken connectivity or restrict libraries' ability to meet local needs.
